goal: dashboard.js: filtered chart fetch, tidy form submit and click cross-filter with toggle (J1; Board gate 175: one value per column, clicking the active bar/slice again removes the filter)

acceptance_criteria.text: dashboard.js fetches /api/datasets/<id>/charts with the page's location.search so the drawn charts equal the server-rendered filtered view; on submit the filter form drops empty fields from the URL (no 'f.region=' or empty from/to) so the address stays clean

A plotly_click on a bar chart or a donut slice whose column is categorical navigates (location.assign, so Back works) to the page URL with f.<column> set to the clicked category (x or label); if that column already has exactly that value the filter is removed instead; other filters stay (AND); other chart kinds do nothing

The clicked column name must reach the JS: if no existing chart field gives it (bar x_label, donut), add a data-column attribute to the figure in dataset.html (minimal change); charts of columns with more than 50 distinct values are not generated, so they never get a click filter

No off-host request is made (existing AC-9 browser checks still pass); python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_filter_browser.py tests/test_browser.py passes
